description: Energía Abierta is the open energy data portal of Chile's Comisión Nacional de Energía. Its interactive visualisations show electricity marginal cost by bus for the last three years, installed capacity in the national system and medium-sized systems, monthly electricity generation, generation from non-conventional renewables by technology, emission factors of the central and north interconnected systems, stored energy in reservoirs, small generation units, electricity sales to regulated customers by commune and region, liquid fuel price explorer at regional, communal and provincial level, hydrocarbon imports and exports, liquid fuel sales, national energy balances and energy consumption variation by sector. The page also links a statistics catalogue, reports, a glossary, a maps portal, a regional portal, a developer API and scenario dashboards for slow recovery, carbon neutrality and accelerated transition. Coverage is Chile, with series starting between 1898 and 2015 depending on the indicator. Access: web portal, free; no licence is stated in the text read. Caveats: the page describes charts, and download formats were not listed. It suits Chilean energy system and fuel market analysis, and no directly related records are catalogued yet.
